name: Multiple Cart Fee – Additional Fees for WooCommerce
author: WooSofts

sections.description:
Multiple Cart Fee lets you create unlimited conditional fees for your WooCommerce store — ideal for adding handling fees, service charges, packaging costs, or product-based surcharges. It’s flexible, powerful, and simple to manage.

Need help? Email support@woosofts.com

🌟 Key Features

  • Add Unlimited Fees: Create multiple fees with custom names and amounts
  • Conditional Logic: Apply fees based on products, categories, or tags
  • Cart Value Rules: Set minimum and maximum cart totals for fee application
  • Tax Support: Enable tax for applied fees and choose tax classes
  • Variation Support: Works with both simple and variable products
  • HPOS Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Lightweight & Easy: Clean, fast, and intuitive admin interface

💼 Perfect For

  • Stores needing extra handling or service fees
  • Shops with packaging or delivery surcharges
  • Businesses that charge category-based or product-based fees
  • WooCommerce stores needing advanced fee control

🚀 Professional Tools

  • Dynamic fee calculation based on cart contents
  • Bulk management for multiple fee rules
  • Intuitive and modern settings interface
  • Built to WooCommerce coding standards
  • Optimized for speed and reliability

Third Party Services

This plugin uses:
* WooCommerce – https://woocommerce.com/

Additional Information

For feedback or assistance, email support@woosofts.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for Multiple Cart Fee
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Multiple Cart Fees to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Upload the entire multiple-cart-fee-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Multiple Cart Fees to begin setup
sections.faq:
Can I add multiple fees?

Yes! You can add unlimited fees with different names, amounts, and conditions.

Does it work with variable products?

Absolutely. The plugin supports both simple and variable products.

Can I set cart amount limits?

Yes. You can define minimum and maximum cart totals for fee application.

Is it compatible with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes. It’s tested and optimized for the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

Can I apply fees by category or product tag?

Yes. You can easily target specific categories, products, or tags.

Where can I get support?

You can reach us anytime at:
* Email: support@woosofts.com
* Support: support@woosofts.com
